$comment: VDR-TFR-NMV: the non-machine information resources (policies, procedures, plans, the operator role, records and registers) and their verification and validation, at least every 3 months. Each entry's last_verified names the decision record in which the operator attests the verification. scripts/check-non-machine-vv.py fails the deploy when an entry is older than max_age_days, its decision is not in force, its file is gone, or a policy or runbook has no entry; the nightly publishes the status as /.well-known/vdr-non-machine-vv.json, whose freshness window is the same 92 days. AI-drafted from the repository on 2026-11-05 for the operator's review.
